title: Fortitude — Internal Recruiting Platform (Proprietary)
goal: Shorten requisition → pipeline → offer cycle time and clarify ownership while honoring privacy/security constraints on candidate data.
summary: End-to-end redesign of recruiting workflows, stage definitions, SLA matrix, and role-based pipeline. Introduced scheduling assistant, readiness indicators, and a small design system to reduce cycle time and increase clarity.

overview.scope: Service design, workflow redesign, design system, research/testing

sections.title: Goal & Constraints
sections.body: Shorten requisition → pipeline → offer cycle time and clarify ownership while honoring privacy/security constraints on candidate data.

sections.title: What I Led
sections.body:
Org & Ops — Client acquisition; proposal/budget; roadmap; resourcing; risk management.
Research & Insights — Recruiter/manager/candidate interviews; shadowing; time-to-hire & drop-off analysis.
Product & IA — Stage definitions; SLA matrix; role-based pipeline IA; structured requisition intake.
Design & Systems — Low/hi-fi flows; scheduling assistant; readiness indicators; design-system tokens/components.
Delivery & Quality — Usability testing program; acceptance criteria; dev handoff & QA.
Stakeholders & Decisions — Cross-functional reviews; prioritization driven by signals (candidate strength, SLA timers, role urgency).

sections.title: Research & Discovery
sections.body: We mapped the current funnel, quantified where delays occurred, and captured role expectations to focus the redesign on scheduling and decision clarity.

sections.title: Mental Models → Workflow Redesign
sections.body: We codified “what’s next” by role, standardized stage gates, and added signal-based prioritization (candidate strength, SLA timers, role urgency).

sections.title: Information Architecture
sections.body: Pipeline views are tailored to recruiters and hiring managers, intake is structured for completeness, and the offer path is auditable.

sections.title: Prototypes (Lo-Fi → Hi-Fi)
sections.body: We delivered a scheduling assistant, SLA and readiness indicators, and task-focused flows; patterns emphasize accessibility and quick error recovery.

sections.title: Operating Mechanisms
sections.body: Stage/SLA matrix, acceptance criteria, recurring usability checks, and decision reviews keep delivery tied to outcomes rather than output.

sections.title: Outcomes
sections.body:
Cycle time shortened; ownership by stage clarified; scheduling failures reduced; recruiter–manager collaboration strengthened.
Ranges: Time-to-hire [↓ ~X–Y%] · SLA adherence [↑ ~X–Y%] · No-shows [↓ ~X–Y%]
